title: Psychic Spark
summary: Add one dart to Magic Missile from any source and cast it once per Long Rest.

fields.Psychic Missiles: Every Magic Missile cast launches one extra dart, including spells cast from spell slots, scrolls and the amulet.
fields.Magic Missile: Action once per Long Rest. The amulet grants the level 1 spell. Four darts, including the extra dart, deal 1d4 + 1 Force each within 60 ft with no attack roll or saving throw. Shield blocks its darts.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by Blurg in the Myconid Colony.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
